title: Interlanguage and Mathematical Translation Methodology Sidecar
version: 2026-07-18 v0.13 corpus, WordWeb, governance, and normalization checkpoints
description:
This is the methodology, provenance, corpus-control, and programme-state sidecar for the mathematical transcription and translation archive. It preserves source-body baselines, weighted-automaton and terminology work, manager handoffs, decision and audit methods, reproducible checks, and bounded interlanguage experiments while the full mathematical readers remain on their author or series records.

Open first: 00_Interlanguage_Methodology_Current_v13_20260718.pdf. It maps the stable Noether, SGA, SGA2, Deligne, and Interlanguage public homes and describes the complete numbered archive rather than only the newest upload.

Retained archive: packages 01-10 preserve the original Claude/ChatGPT programme dump, full source-body baselines grouped by language family, weighted automata, term ledgers, inventories, hashes, Fable method transfers, and route-context returns. Packages 11-16 retain the consolidated workflow, research-department and automata materials, Interslavic and Romance methodology, the Noether R823 completion gate, and the eight-lane language-manager fleet snapshot.

New organized checkpoints: package 17a consolidates the public-safe Romance corpus metadata, WordWeb/access state, append-only decision governance, controlled-Romance T001-T008 profile, bounded T008 TeX/PDF, integrated acceptance evidence, and metadata-only Rumantsch Grischun school-algebra intake. Package 17b records Interslavic normalization through Tranche 007 and the final 221-unit audit. Package 17c is the exact compact public WordWeb/access checkpoint for direct reuse.

Measured boundaries: Romance WordWeb contains 60 concepts, 106 explicit senses, 811 metadata-only evidence records, 954 sense-by-cohort rows, and 28 unsupported-sense gaps. Controlled Romance covers eight bounded units and 19 aggregate PDF pages with continuation at German R823 line 21309. The paired Noether Interslavic corpus contains 221 Latin-script and 221 Cyrillic-script units; Tranches 003-007 record 1,111 replacements across 247 distinct units. The final audit retains 353 vazi*|vaze* mathematical probes as an external-authority blocker.

Classification: these are model-built methodology, corpus, normalization, and working-translation artifacts. They do not claim native-language validation, human intelligibility results, pilot readiness, form promotion, community certification, rights clearance, critical-edition status, peer review, or universal mathematical/source-fidelity certification.

GitHub: corrections and stronger evidence can be proposed at https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: v0.13 retains the complete numbered methodology/provenance archive and adds organized public-safe Romance, WordWeb/access, and Interslavic normalization checkpoints. Public projections are path/task-ID scanned; excluded raw rights-restricted evidence remains private.
